answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the marble is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the cedar of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
